meta.title: An object level
meta.subtitle: Entered from start on {; object_ prefix dropped; eatws runs between any two states

states.label: field_start
states.explanation: Accepts a double quote (and, even in STRICT mode, a single quote: bug hunt finding 4) to start a key, or '}' to close an empty object.

states.label: field
states.explanation: A tight inner loop copies key bytes into tok->pb until the closing quote, then strdup()s it into obj_field_name. A backslash detours through the escape states.

states.label: field_end
states.explanation: Requires ':' after the key; anything else is error parse_object_key_sep.

states.label: value
states.explanation: Checks the depth limit, sets this level to object_value_add, then depth++ and resets the new level to eatws/start. The member's value is parsed one level deeper.

states.label: value_add
states.explanation: Runs right after the child level finished and handed its value back in the local obj. Adds it to current under obj_field_name and frees the key.

states.label: object_sep
states.explanation: ',' goes to object_field_start_after_sep (where '}' is rejected in STRICT mode); '}' finishes the object.

states.label: field_start_after_sep
states.explanation: Same code as object_field_start, except that '}' here means a trailing comma, which STRICT mode rejects.

states.label: finish
states.explanation: At depth 0 the call jumps to out:. Deeper, it takes a reference to current into the local obj, resets this level, decrements depth and re-checks the same byte in the parent's state (array_add or object_value_add).

states.label: goto out
states.explanation: Every state sets tok->err and jumps to out: on a byte it cannot accept.
